floater.name: folderstorm_crashes
floater.title: Folderstorm crash reporting
floater.text: Send native crash reports to Folderstorm's Sentry project. Off by default. Minidumps can contain process memory and personal information. This choice applies to the host and all character viewers on this computer.

check_box.name: enabled
check_box.label: Allow crash reports
check_box.tool_tip: No chat logs or screenshots are attached. Turning this off stops future uploads after each process observes the change; an upload already sent cannot be recalled.

button.name: report
button.label: Report a bug…
button.tool_tip: Review and submit a GitHub issue. No crash dump is attached.
